arxiv-1909-06821.creator: F. Ramezani
arxiv-1909-06821.description: Abstract We construct infinitely many signed graphs having symmetric spectrum, by using the NEPS and rooted product of signed graphs. We also present a method for constructing large cospectral signed graphs. arxiv-2410-08304.title: Global Lyapunov functions: a long-standing open problem in mathematics, with symbolic transformers
arxiv-2410-08304.creator: Alberto Alfarano, François Charton, Amaury Hayat
arxiv-2410-08304.description: Abstract Despite their spectacular progress, language models still struggle on complex reasoning tasks, such as advanced mathematics. We consider a long-standing open problem in mathematics: discovering a Lyapunov function that ensures the global stability of a dynamical system. This problem has no known general solution, and algorithmic solvers only exist for some small polynomial systems.

arxiv-2507-13572.title: Temporal Adaptation of Pre-trained Foundation Models for Music Structure Analysis
arxiv-2507-13572.description: Abstract Audio-based music structure analysis (MSA) is an essential task in Music Information Retrieval that remains challenging due to the complexity and variability of musical form. Recent advances highlight the potential of fine-tuning pre-trained music foundation models for MSA tasks.

pmc-11294626.title: Skin cancer detection through attention guided dual autoencoder approach with extreme learning machine
pmc-11294626.creator: Ritesh Maurya, Satyajit Mahapatra, Malay Kishore Dutta, Vibhav Prakash Singh, Mohan Karnati, Geet Sahu, Nageshwar Nath Pandey
pmc-11294626.description: Skin cancer is a lethal disease, and its early detection plays a pivotal role in preventing its spread to other body organs and tissues. Artificial Intelligence (AI)-based automated methods can play a significant role in its early detection. This study presents an AI-based novel approach, termed 'DualAutoELM' for the effective identification of various types of skin cancers.

pmc-11408508.title: Quantum-inspired clustering with light
pmc-11408508.creator: Miguel Varga, Pablo Bermejo, Ruben Pellicer-Guridi, Román Orús, Gabriel Molina-Terriza
pmc-11408508.description: This article introduces a novel approach to perform the simulation of a single qubit quantum-inspired algorithm using laser beams. Leveraging the polarization states of photonic qubits, and inspired by variational quantum eigensolvers, we develop a variational quantum-inspired algorithm implementing a clustering procedure following the approach proposed by some of us in SciRep 13, 13284 (2023).

pmc-11501474.title: Advances in Imaging for Metastatic Epidural Spinal Cord Compression: A Comprehensive Review of Detection, Diagnosis, and Treatment Planning
pmc-11501474.creator: Paschyanti R Kasat, Shivali V Kashikar, Pratapsingh Parihar, Pratiksha Sachani, Priyal Shrivastava, Smruti A Mapari, Utkarsh Pradeep, Gautam N Bedi, Paritosh N Bhangale
pmc-11501474.description: Metastatic epidural spinal cord compression (MESCC) is a critical oncologic emergency caused by the invasion of metastatic tumors into the spinal epidural space, leading to compression of the spinal cord. If not promptly diagnosed and treated, MESCC can result in irreversible neurological deficits, including paralysis, significantly impacting the patient's quality of life.

pmc-13049088.title: Identification and validation of prognostic genes associated with integrative stress response in lung adenocarcinoma and construction of the risk models
pmc-13049088.creator: Jianjun Fu, Yunming Tao, Wu Liu
pmc-13049088.description: ​Integrated stress response (ISR) genes are implicated in lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) prognosis, but their clinical utility remains unexplored. This study aims to identify ISR-related prognostic genes and construct a risk model for LUAD survival prediction.​ LUAD transcriptomic and clinical data were retrieved from public databases. ISR-related genes (ISR-RGs) were screened via differential expression and regression analysis.

pmc-13133657.title: Fabrication of antibacterial silver nanoparticle-loaded PVA/chitosan microfibers via forcespinning for wastewater disinfection
pmc-13133657.creator: Vu Viet Linh Nguyen, H. Long Nguyen, Duc-Quang Hoang, Dai Phu Huynh
pmc-13133657.description: Water pollution has become a serious environmental problem in many countries of Southeast Asia, affecting both civil and industrial wastewater. Various research approaches have been employed to purify wastewater, such as using absorbent membranes for heavy metal ions and dyes as well as disinfection using antimicrobial agents.

pmc-13486445.title: A machine learning-guided epithelial plasticity score refines prognostication and immune-context stratification in muscle-invasive bladder cancer
pmc-13486445.creator: Difei Yu, Yu Zhang, Jiarun Tang, Jing Qing, Ke Hu, Jiamo Zhang
pmc-13486445.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). PurposeMuscle-invasive bladder cancer (MIBC) remains biologically heterogeneous, and clinicopathological variables do not fully capture epithelial-state remodeling linked to progression and treatment response. We developed an epithelial plasticity-related risk score (EPRS) and evaluated its prognostic, biological, and immunological relevance.MethodsUsing 368 primary TCGA-MIBC cases, we built a basal-luminal plasticity axis and integrated differential expression, correlation with the continuous plasticity index, and survival association to define 331 candidate genes.

pmc-13623248.title: Hindi translation and cross-cultural adaptation of the Liverpool University Neuroleptic Side-effect Rating Scale (LUNSERS): A cognitive debriefing study
pmc-13623248.creator: Hemant Choudhary, Tulika Shukla, Vaibhav Patil, Koushik S. Deb, Rakesh K. Chadda, Mamta Sood
pmc-13623248.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background:The Liverpool University Neuroleptic Side-Effect Rating Scale (LUNSERS) is a comprehensive self-report tool for assessing subjective adverse events during antipsychotic treatment.Aim:We aimed to translate LUNSERS into Hindi for its application in the Indian population.Methods:We followed the translation methodology provided by the World Health Organization (WHO) and the International Society for Pharmacoeconomics and Outcomes Research (ISPOR) 2005 task force (English to Hindi).

pmc-13664850.title: In Situ Fusarium Mycotoxin Mitigation During Wholegrain Wheat Flour Fermentation with Sourdough Lactic Acid Bacteria and Further Insights into Reduction Mechanisms
pmc-13664850.creator: Giuseppe Perri, Claudia Sardella, Lorenzo Ciraldo, Valentina Scarpino, Simona Carbone, Federico Rametta, Massimo Blandino, Carlo Giuseppe Rizzello, Erica Pontonio
pmc-13664850.description: Fusarium mycotoxins are major contaminants of cereal-based products, yet effective clean-label mitigation strategies are still limited. Although lactic acid bacteria (LAB) have been extensively investigated as biological tools for mycotoxin reduction, evidence is largely based on in vitro studies. Here, nineteen LAB strains representative of sourdough microbiota were screened for their ability to reduce deoxynivalenol (DON) in wholegrain wheat dough.
